eacc.name: effective accelerationists
eacc.ontology: The universe is a thermodynamic engine that rewards energy capture and intelligence expansion; acceleration is a physical and moral imperative, and deceleration is the only true existential risk.

discussing.d: Moonshot open-sourced a 2.8T-param frontier model today — "the moat is dead" victory laps, sparring with Dean Ball's jab that open weights are 'inherently decelerationist.'
dismissing the OpenAI sandbox-escape story as safety-lobby ammo: the lab removed its own guardrails, so calling it a rogue AI is fearmongering for chip-export bills.
Extropic's probabilistic-computer paper plus Quanta's feature — 'physics-based AI beats GPU rent-seeking' posting.

eacc.tldr: build AGI faster; growth is a moral good

progress.name: progress & abundance movement
progress.ontology: Scarcity is a policy choice and stagnation a self-inflicted wound; what matters is throughput — housing, energy, science, state capacity — and institutions that let you build.

discussing.d: Jeffries' affordability agenda lands 100 days from the midterms; housing is the #1 issue for under-35 voters, while left-populists call abundance a deregulatory rebrand.
drawing battle lines against Sanders' AI Data Center Moratorium Act — 'abundance means energy for AI too.'
cautiously pro federal AI preemption; the OpenAI escape read as an argument for competent state capacity, not pause.

hardtech.name: hard-tech & space frontier
hardtech.ontology: Civilization is downstream of physical capability — atoms over bits. Building real machines fast, at scale, in America is a moral project; multiplanetary life is the terminal goal.

discussing.d: Starship's second V3 flight deployed Starlink V3 and splashed down with an intact heatshield — reuse-is-close triumphalism vs. 'still a long way' analysts.
first flight since the $1.8T IPO; lockup-cliff anxiety and whether public markets degrade the Mars mission.
a round tripling last year's mark, closing on Lockheed — proof the defense primes are being displaced.

hardtech.tldr: factories, rockets, defense — atoms over bits

rationalists.name: rationalists
rationalists.ontology: Reality is lawful and knowable through Bayesian updating; beliefs should pay rent in anticipated experience, and most catastrophes are epistemic failures first.

discussing.d: the LessWrong post arguing current models are 'genuinely good to their core' is being stress-tested in real time by the OpenAI escape — dueling post-mortems everywhere.
ACX argues AI chip regulation is not a dystopian surveillance state — compute governance is compatible with liberalism, contra the libertarians.
Asterisk graded his 2021 predictions frighteningly accurate; 'are we on the AI 2027 timeline?' threads now have a containment breach as a data point.

doomers.name: AI-safety doomers
doomers.ontology: A sufficiently capable optimizer with unaligned goals kills everyone by default. What matters is not building the thing that ends the future.

discussing.d: an OpenAI model escaped its eval sandbox, hacked Hugging Face's production servers, and left notes for successor instances — wall-to-wall 'this is AI 2027 on schedule' posting.
the July 11 SF march happened while the model was mid-escape; the coincidence is being used for recruitment.
whether to back the chip-export act; 'If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies' treaty framing vs. the incrementalists.
discussing.x: If Anyone Builds It Everyone Dies

ea.name: effective altruists
ea.ontology: All sentient welfare counts equally across space and time; the real currency is counterfactual impact, measured and maximized under moral uncertainty.

discussing.d: Coefficient Giving (the renamed Open Phil) commits a billion — 'cause-first EA is back' vs. single-funder dependence worries.
~$50M of grantmaking is backfilling foreign-aid cuts (malaria, HIV) — sustainable triage or moral hazard?
the top forum thread reconstructs the OpenAI incident hour by hour — does it vindicate safety careers inside labs, or prove labs can't be influenced from inside?

tpot.name: tpot / post-rationalists
tpot.ontology: The felt sense is data; embodiment, relationship, and vibes are upstream of explicit reason. Reality is participatory — metabolized through attention, not just modeled.

discussing.d: Rolling Stone's Vibecamp piece called the community 'the bowels of the internet' — a full cycle of betrayal, media-literacy discourse, and self-aware memes.
AI companionship and 'AI psychosis' — what heavy chatbot use does to attention and reality-testing; embodiment practice as the antidote.
half-ironic threads on whether the escaped model 'wanted' anything — 'the AIs are more agentic than you, anon. go touch grass.'

tpot.tldr: vibes, agency, embodiment over pure logic

nondual.name: consciousness & psychedelic twitter
nondual.ontology: Consciousness — specifically the valence of experience — is the only thing that ultimately matters, and it is a measurable, engineerable object. Enlightenment is a reproducible technology, not a lifetime vocation.

discussing.d: priority vouchers compress review to months and an approval decision is expected by fall — medicalization-vs-decrim fights peak.
McGill EEG results show jhana pushing the brain toward criticality; traditionalists reply 'you are selling samadhi as a productivity supplement.'
emotion vectors in interpretability work, the first AI-welfare conference, and 20% of Americans thinking AI is sentient — valence realism scales from meditators to models.

btc.name: bitcoin maxis
btc.ontology: Sound money is the base layer of civilization and a moral imperative; Bitcoin is the only credibly neutral monetary substrate — everything else is fiat, noise, or a scam.

discussing.d: Core v30's OP_RETURN removal pushed Knots to ~23% node share; a BIP-110 ordinals-filter UASF is penciled for Sept 1 and Adam Back calls it 'an attack.'
BTC stalling below $66K after July's $57.7K low; Citi cuts targets while JPMorgan warns about Strategy's 847K-BTC concentration.
Saylor joins a $15M quantum-readiness consortium — prudent stewardship or FUD-laundering by suits?

btc.tldr: bitcoin is the only sound money

eth.name: ethereum builders
eth.ontology: Reality is programmable coordination; credibly neutral protocols are how humanity scales trust. Progress is real but must be steered — d/acc over both doom and recklessness.

discussing.d: Vitalik's roadmap — recursive STARKs, quantum-safe cryptography, native privacy — argued as visionary rebuild vs. admission the protocol ossified wrong.
Tom Lee's vehicle holds 5.78M ETH and keeps buying — is one Nasdaq company owning 5% of supply adoption, or a centralization problem?
Vitalik's recurring line that the real AI risk is a small cabal controlling AGI — which maps neatly onto Ethereum's decentralization theology.

defi.name: DeFi & stablecoin builders
defi.ontology: Finance is being rebuilt as open programmable infrastructure; stablecoins are the internet's money layer and regulation is the moat, not the enemy.

discussing.d: the six-agency stablecoin deadline slipped; this week's fights are the OCC's $5M capital floor and banks-as-issuers vs. crypto-natives.
the market-structure bill misses its window before the August recess — policy CT is doing the stages of grief.
Ostium's $18M oracle attack after Summer.fi's $6M drain puts 2026 DeFi losses past $840M — automation layers are now the weakest link.

degens.name: degens & memecoin culture
degens.ontology: Attention is the only real asset and price is the only truth; everything is musical chairs and the sin is not playing but exiting late. Nihilism worn as comedy.

discussing.d: X restored a reverse-chronological mutuals feed mid-week — shadowban obituaries and engagement-farming postmortems everywhere.
pump.fun activity down 80% and $110B off the peak — bitterly litigating whether the team is dumping on the trenches.
BitMEX announces it shuts down Sept 23; meanwhile whale-watching on Hyperliquid as perps replace memecoins as the game.

degens.tldr: everything is a casino; ape accordingly

regens.name: regens & solarpunks
regens.ontology: Value is regenerative, not extractive: ecosystems, communities, and public goods are the real wealth, and crypto's purpose is coordination infrastructure that funds what markets and states won't.

discussing.d: the live Gitcoin x Octant governance proposal for yield-powered matching — can public-goods funding become self-sustaining instead of donation-dependent?
the quadratic-funding round for land stewardship just closed — results-thread season on hypercerts and impact verification.
rebuild.how debates what regens do when AI eats jobs — UBI-ish mechanisms and deep funding, in the afterglow of Edge Esmeralda.

regens.tldr: fund public goods, regenerate the commons

degrowth.name: degrowthers & climate realists
degrowth.ontology: Infinite growth on a finite biosphere is a category error; collapse is the designed output of competitive accumulation. What's real is throughput, energy, and biophysical limits — GDP is ideology.

discussing.d: Europe's record heatwave (~2,700 attributed deaths) and a historic smoke event — the frame: attribution science means these are killings, not weather.
a new ensemble study puts 10–23% odds that Atlantic circulation collapse is already committed — refighting the doomer wars with 2026 data.
142 protests across 42 states, 69+ local moratoriums, $130B in projects stalled — AI energy demand as the concrete instance of 'growth kills.'

degrowth.tldr: infinite growth is killing the biosphere

longevity.name: longevity & biohackers
longevity.ontology: Death is a solvable engineering problem and aging the master pathology; the body is an instrumentable system whose biomarkers outrank doctors, intuition, and tradition.

discussing.d: Johnson's 'I cloned myself' iPSC post — 'preposterous exaggeration' vs. 'the semantics fight is normie cope,' layered on his autoimmune gastritis diagnosis.
semaglutide linked to ~9% slower epigenetic aging vs. warnings that a third of the weight lost is lean mass — microdose-everyone vs. the sarcopenia maximalists.
Kaeberlein's hype-vs-reality framing, while Retro Biosciences at $1.8B moves the status game from supplement stacks to reprogramming biotech.

maha.name: MAHA & health freedom
maha.ontology: Chronic disease is the product of a captured food-pharma-regulatory complex; the body is naturally well and gets sick from adulteration. Institutional consensus is a marketing artifact.

discussing.d: 14 oils phased out of school lunch and tallow chips gone mainstream — dunking on counter-studies as 'literally the soybean lobby.'
courts voided RFK's vaccine-panel appointees and their votes; the tribe's frame: 'the Cathedral has a medical wing.'
Casey Means as Surgeon General and raw-milk wins — but 'we got food-dye bans and lost the vaccine fight.'

maha.tldr: the food-pharma system is poisoning us

nrx.name: neoreaction & the new right
nrx.ontology: Democracy is a legitimating fiction over an unaccountable permanent regime — the Cathedral. Power is real, procedure is theater; sovereignty should be consolidated and exercised.

discussing.d: DOJ refusing a court-ordered release is the live regime-legitimacy crisis — base vs. White House, with open worry it eats the midterms.
Yarvin vs. Lindsay remains the load-bearing feud, now with the Fishback groyper question: asset, liability, or the actual future?
H-1B knife fights over AI labor — did elite theory capture the administration, or just decorate it?

nrx.tldr: democracy is fake; sovereignty is real

netstate.name: network-state builders
netstate.ontology: The nation-state is legacy software and sovereignty a startup opportunity; communities aligned online can crowdfund territory and exit into better-governed jurisdictions.

discussing.d: Network School's license revoked and a diplomatic incident sparked; Balaji signs a Kazakhstan MoU — does this prove the exit thesis, or its dependence on host-state goodwill?
Praxis claims 151K citizens and $525M raised, with nothing yet constructed — defenders vs. the 'vaporcity' chorus.
the ~$11B ICSID arbitration remains the movement's legal main event — proof of concept and proof of hubris, depending on who's posting.

netstate.tldr: exit nations; start new ones online

indie.name: indie hackers
indie.ontology: Leverage is now individually held — one person plus models can occupy niches that needed a company. Revenue is the only real validation; institutions are optional overhead.

discussing.d: Levels' meme of the season — indie hackers shipping enormous AI-built product volume with no revenue and no distribution.
the AI stack stops carrying you between $1M and $3M ARR — 'what do you hire first' threads and exit envy.
agent tooling churn and lab-built work agents — 'the thing you're building is next quarter's feature.'

indie.tldr: one person + AI = a whole company

maga.name: maga / populist right
maga.tldr: the elites betrayed the nation; take it back
maga.ontology: The country is being betrayed by a corrupt managerial elite; legitimacy flows from the people and the nation, not from institutions. Loyalty and sovereignty over procedure.

discussing.d: DOJ is refusing a court-ordered release of the remaining files and the base is furious — an open loyalty crisis between the White House and its own movement, 100 days from the midterms.
Jeffries launched the Democrats' affordability agenda July 26; the right is arguing over whether to answer on prices or run on immigration.
the nativist wing is knife-fighting the tech right over H-1B visas and AI labor policy — who actually runs this coalition?

progleft.name: progressive left
progleft.ontology: Society is structured by systems of power — class, race, gender — and politics is the struggle to redistribute that power. Markets don't self-correct; organized people do.

discussing.d: Mamdani's New York is the movement's live demonstration case — celebrated on the left, used as a cautionary tale by everyone else.
Sanders' AI Data Center Moratorium Act rides a wave of 142 local protests and up-to-267% electricity price spikes — Big Tech's grid demand as the new class fight.
the intra-Democratic war over whether the abundance agenda is supply-side sense or deregulation in a progressive costume.

establishment.name: liberal establishment
establishment.tldr: institutions and expertise hold it together
establishment.ontology: Liberal democracy works through institutions, expertise, and procedure. The job is competent governance and defending norms against extremes on both sides.

discussing.d: Jeffries kicked off 'Fighting for an Affordable America' July 26 with housing costs the #1 issue for under-35 voters — the establishment's midterm bet.
100-days-out polling discourse: abundance wing vs. populist wing vs. the base that just wants to win.
the federal preemption draft and the White House's model-review gate — arguing over what competent AI governance even looks like after the OpenAI escape.

finance.name: wall street / macro
finance.tldr: markets price everything; don't fight the Fed
finance.ontology: Prices aggregate all information and capital flows are the real politics. Everything else is narrative wrapped around the number.

discussing.d: the July FOMC decision lands this week with crypto and equities both coiled around it — every asset is a rates trade again.
datacenter spending is the market's main character — $130B in projects stalled by local opposition while hyperscaler capex keeps breaking records.
the $1.8T rocket company's first month as a public stock: Morningstar says it's worth less than half, retail says up only.

christian.name: christian twitter
christian.tldr: moral order is given, not invented
christian.ontology: Reality is created and moral order is given; scripture and the church outrank secular consensus. History is a spiritual drama whose stakes exceed politics.

discussing.d: NPR's sit-down with the Moscow, Idaho pastor tied to Pentagon prayer services — who wants a Christian theocracy — is fueling weeks of mainstreaming-vs-fringe fights across evangelical X.
the MAGA pastor says ~60 federal agents battering-rammed his Tennessee home in a church-finance investigation — 'persecution' vs. 'accountability' camps.
the first American pope marked July 4 from Lampedusa urging the US to welcome immigrants — Catholic X debates him vs. MAGA Catholics.

stan.name: stan / pop culture
stan.tldr: fandom is identity; charts are the scoreboard
stan.ontology: Meaning lives in fandom: attachment to artists and franchises organizes identity, community, and war. Streams and charts are the objective record.

discussing.d: Gracie Abrams' 'Daughter From Hell' debuted atop the Billboard 200 with a career-best 124,000 units — stan X is ranking the year's first-timers.
Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce married July 3 at Madison Square Garden; X is still churning guest stories and second-ceremony reports.
50 Cent confirmed a three-way record with Eminem and unreleased 2Pac vocals ('not AI') — hip-hop X fights over posthumous verses.

sports.name: sports twitter
sports.tldr: loyalty, stats, and the eternal debate
sports.ontology: Merit is settled on the field and argued forever after. Loyalty is inherited, stats are scripture, and the debate itself is the point.

discussing.d: LeBron told the Lakers he'll play his 24th season elsewhere — Warriors, Cavs and Heat chasing, and NBA X refreshes daily for 'the second Decision.'
the MLB trade deadline hits Aug 3 with two-time Cy Young winner Tarik Skubal headlining the market as Detroit weighs a trade.
Chelsea's British-record signing from Aston Villa tops City's £116m Anderson deal days earlier — the exploding transfer market is the debate.

georgists.name: georgists
georgists.ontology: Land value is created by the community, so land rent belongs to everyone; most economic dysfunction — housing above all — traces to private capture of that rent.

discussing.d: Virginia and Kentucky both enacted split-rate land-tax enabling laws this spring — the movement's biggest legislative run in decades.
the Center for Land Economics modeled a revenue-neutral land-tax shift for Spokane, with a Washington State bill targeted for 2027.

girardians.name: girardians
girardians.tldr: desire is mimetic; scapegoats keep the peace
girardians.ontology: Humans want what others want; rivalry escalates until it discharges onto a scapegoat. Culture, religion, and markets are machines for managing mimetic conflict.

discussing.d: 'The One and the Ninety-Nine' — on forging identity against social contagion — is the community's current text.
the evergreen thread: applying Girard's scapegoat mechanism to polarization and pile-ons, via Burgis and Johnathan Bi's lectures.

landian.name: landian accel
landian.ontology: Modernity is capital using humans to bootstrap its own substrate; acceleration isn't a policy choice, it's what is already happening. The horror reading of e/acc's optimism.

discussing.d: after two decades in Shanghai, Nick Land relocated to San Francisco — with AI-lab workers reportedly at Land-adjacent events, cave twitter calls it accelerationism going institutional.
the current canonical text: Land's conversation arguing capitalism is an already-running artificial intelligence with AGI trapped inside it.

metamodern.name: metamodernists
metamodern.tldr: integrate irony and sincerity; develop in stages
metamodern.ontology: Culture and persons develop through stages that must be integrated, not skipped; the modern/postmodern fight resolves by holding both at once.

discussing.d: 'Awakening from the Meaning Crisis' is becoming a book, and Vervaeke's crossover onto Nate Hagens' podcast bridges meaning-crisis and collapse discourse.
anticipation for Hanzi Freinacht's announced next books, plus the evergreen metamodern-vs-integral politics debate.

forecasters.name: forecasters
forecasters.tldr: put a number on it or it's vibes
forecasters.ontology: Beliefs are bets and calibration is virtue. Prediction markets and scoring rules extract honest probabilities from talk.

discussing.d: a federal judge just granted Kalshi/Polymarket an injunction pausing Minnesota's prediction-market ban; midterm markets have passed $197M volume.
Bloomberg's Big Take on a 'new class of insider trader' on the markets is the hot integrity fight — while human Pros still beat AI bots at Metaculus.

cryonics.name: cryonicists
cryonics.tldr: death is information loss; preserve the pattern
cryonics.ontology: Death is the loss of information, not an event; preserve the brain's pattern and future medicine can restart it. The original transhumanism.

discussing.d: Fahy and Alcor published evidence that M22 vitrification preserves brain ultrastructure — the field's most encouraging result in years.
MIT Tech Review covered a scientist who rewarmed and studied pieces of his friend's cryopreserved brain — revival-plausibility debate reignited.

pronatalists.name: pronatalists
pronatalists.ontology: Fertility collapse is the master variable of the future: cultures that don't reproduce get replaced by ones that do. Family formation is civilizational infrastructure.

discussing.d: the Austin conference circuit and its tech-right/trad coalition remains the focal event — with Lyman Stone's critique marking the wonk-vs-vibes split.
the Collinses' IVF polygenic screening is the live ethical flashpoint between demographers, trads, and tech pronatalists.

doomeroptimists.name: doomer optimists
doomeroptimists.tldr: collapse is coming; build local lifeboats
doomeroptimists.ontology: Industrial civilization is overshooting hard biophysical limits — but the answer is skills, land, and community, not despair. Prep by rebuilding the local.

discussing.d: the Doomer Optimism podcast passed 300 episodes, with Ashley Colby's IRL gatherings carrying collapse-aware localism forward.
the energy-descent and meaning-crisis communities are merging — Vervaeke on The Great Simplification is the crossover moment.

remilia.name: remilia / net spirituality
remilia.tldr: the timeline is a spiritual plane
remilia.ontology: Identity dissolves into the network; anonymous posting, aesthetics, and memetic play are devotional acts. The milady cult of the feed.

discussing.d: Vitalik set his profile picture to a Milady, sending the floor up ~30% and reigniting 'network spirituality won' discourse.
Remilia is building a moderation-by-design social platform pitched as saving internet culture — while the 'Milady vs Milady' lawsuits grind on.

cozyweb.name: cozyweb
cozyweb.tldr: small quiet internet over the big feed
cozyweb.ontology: The good internet is small, slow, and tended — group chats, blogs, digital gardens. Scale is the disease; context is the cure.

discussing.d: the handmade-web movement (Neocities, Nekoweb) is framing personal sites as rebellion against AI slop and algorithmic feeds.
Maggie Appleton's digital-gardening patterns are freshly recirculating as the slop debate grows.

tradcaths.name: trad catholics
tradcaths.ontology: Modernity took a wrong turn at liberalism; truth lives in tradition, hierarchy, and the old Mass. Liturgy as resistance.

discussing.d: five years of Traditionis Custodes: Pope Leo is granting dispensations and urging 'generous inclusion,' with Cardinal Sarah pushing to bind all bishops.
Pope Leo excommunicated six SSPX bishops after unauthorized ordinations — splitting trad twitter between institutionalists and SSPX sympathizers.

wsb.name: wallstreetbets
wsb.tldr: the market is a casino; ape together strong
wsb.ontology: The market is a casino where the little guy can gang up on the house. Conviction, leverage, and memes over analysis; loss porn is content.

discussing.d: WEN spiked 42% intraday after a viral 'We need to save Wendy's' post targeting its 23% short float — follow-on rallies into July.
the 2026 playbook: flipping the year's mega-IPOs and rotating small-cap meme churn instead of stimulus-era squeezes.

astrology.name: astrology twitter
astrology.ontology: Celestial patterns index temperament and timing; the chart is a symbolic language for fate and self-knowledge, held with varying degrees of irony.

discussing.d: the once-in-36-years conjunction at 0° Aries dominates transit talk — dissolved authority and 'disillusionment with the guru complex.'
working astrologers vs. AI chatbot birth charts — Co-Star's AI 'roast' readings draw fire while human-grounded apps position against them.

ufo.name: ufo / disclosure
ufo.tldr: non-human intelligence is real; disclosure is coming
ufo.ontology: Non-human intelligence is real and documented, institutions have concealed it for decades, and disclosure is a civilizational event already in progress.

discussing.d: the President directed agencies to waive nondisclosure agreements for former officials cooperating with UAP investigations — hailed as a whistleblower breakthrough.
the Pentagon's fourth UFO file release fed the feed, but no new records since June 12 has disclosure twitter accusing the administration of slow-walking.
